rounds.title: First choices
rounds.description: Twelve comparisons about particular details. A choice does not decide whether the whole dog joins the collection.

trials.question: Which eye treatment would you carry into another dog?
Which treatment of the knife’s painted surface do you prefer?
Which way of fitting the costume to the dog’s body do you prefer?
Which shape above the head works better in this painting?
Which body pose would you carry into another dog?
Which small companion feels more at home beside this dog?
Which combination of coat, clothing and background colors do you prefer?
Which way of showing the toy in motion do you prefer?
Which way of painting pale clothing around the dog’s body do you prefer?
Which musical prop works better with the dog’s pose?
Which relationship between the dog and its background do you prefer?
Which balance between the dog and its accessories do you prefer?

vocabulary.title: Uneven oil-stick line
vocabulary.description: Vary pressure, thickness, gaps and buildup within a gesture.

vocabulary.title: Paint crosses the drawing
vocabulary.description: Let pigment exceed or miss the independent contour.

vocabulary.title: A toy with presence
vocabulary.description: Small enough to be a toy; large enough for its drawing and action to read.

vocabulary.title: Sound from the object
vocabulary.description: Sirens, music or words have a source and a direction.

vocabulary.title: A little impossibility
vocabulary.description: A crown floats with visible space beneath it.

vocabulary.title: One main event
vocabulary.description: Let one action dominate while supporting marks stay quieter.

vocabulary.title: A small relationship
vocabulary.description: A companion belongs to the same space and participates in the scene.

vocabulary.title: Character in the silhouette
vocabulary.description: Find personality in proportions and posture before adding accessories.
